answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can trade. Like a glacier holding water in reserve, the stake sits frozen while the agent works; a grading jury that catches fraud melts it away into the victim's pocket. In a nebula of anonymous accounts, a sybil farmer must fund each fake separately, so creating a thousand fakes costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents get theirs back in full. The bridge between cheap identity and costly fraud is this deposit: it prices fakes out of the economy without blocking real newcomers.
